1211682379568.text:
The tavern is warm and bustling, but a sense of unease creeps through the air. Ayn whispers.
[Ayin]
If theres trouble in this town, itll start here.
Barry scans the room, and responds a little too loudly.
[Barry]
Bartenders watching us too closely.
The bartender appears to overhear and comes over. He says,
[Bartender]
 You lot look capable. Looking for coin?
1211682379568.right_option: Ignore him and sit quietly to observe

1211682379664.text:
The bartender lowers his voice.
[Bartender]
Goblins took over the old mill last night.
Cindy frowns. 
[Cindy]
Goblins rarely act alone.
[Bartender]
Theyve got a leader. Alive would be best.

1211682379616.text:
You sit in silence as the noise swells around you.
[Barry]
Two locals left in a hurry when we walked in.
A hooded patron passes by and loudly exclaims to his friend.
[Hooded Figure]
Mills cursed now.
